WITH yearly_consumption AS (

        AND SUBSTRING(ym."date" FROM 1 FOR 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY
        c."segment", SUBSTRING(ym."date" FROM 1 FOR 4)
),
segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        "segment",
        MAX(CASE WHEN "year" = '2012' THEN "total_consumption" ELSE NULL END) AS "consumption_2012",
        MAX(CASE WHEN "year" = '2013' THEN "total_consumption" ELSE NULL END) AS "consumption_2013"
    FROM
        yearly_consumption
    WHERE
        "segment" IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY
        "segment"
),
percentage_change AS (
    SELECT
        "segment",
        "consumption_2012",
        "consumption_2013",
        CASE
            WHEN "consumption_2012" = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE (("consumption_2013" - "consumption_2012")::FLOAT / "consumption_2012") * 100
        END AS "percentage_increase"
    FROM
        segment_consumption
)
SELECT
    "segment",
    "percentage_increase"
FROM

    "percentage_increase" IS NOT NULL
